chapter.verse: Tua ciangin misite' lakpan a thawhkiksak Lazarus' omna khua Bethany ah Paisan Pawi tun ma ni guk sapin Jesu hong pai hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu nitak an nekpih uh hi. Martha ankuang vil hi a, Lazarus pen Jesu tawh a tukhawm annete lakah kihel hi.
Tua ciangin Mary in nard nilhthau namtui ci-tak a manpha mahmah pound khat la a, Jesu' khete nilhin a sam tawh nul hi. Inn sung teng zong nilhthau gimnamtui kizel hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu' nungzuite khat ahi (Jesu a lehhek dingpa) Judas Iscariot in,
“Hih nilhthau denarii zathum tawh zuakin mizawngte kipia leh hizaw lo hiam?” ci hi.
Hih bang a gen ciangin mizawngte a khualna hilo a, amah sumbawm a len hi-in a sunga kikoihte a sawk den guta khat ahih man ahi hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in, “Ka kivui ni' ading nilhthau a koihcing theih nadingin amah hici omsak lel un.
A hang pen note' kiangah mizawngte a om den hi a, ahi zongin nomau' kiangah kei a om den ka hikei hi,” ci hi.
Tua mun ah Jesu om cih a theih uh ciangin Jesu' hang bek hilo, misite' lakpan Jesu' thawhkiksak Lazarus en dingin Jew mihon tampite hong pai uh hi.
Tua ahih manin siampi liante in Lazarus zong thah dingin vaihawm uh hi.
Ama' hangin Jew mi tampite paikhia-in Jesu um uh ahih man ahi hi.
A zingciangin pawi siim dinga pai mihonpi in Jerusalem ah Jesu hong pai ding cih thu za uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute in nisuh hiangte khiakin Jesu dawn dingin kuankhia uh a, “Hosanna! Topa' min tawh hong pai Israel Kumpipa thuphangah ahi hi!” ci-in awng uh hi.
Jesu zong lano khat mu-in a tungah tuang a, tua pen a kigelhsa bang lian ahi hi:
“Zion' tanu aw, lau ke'n maw; na kumpipa hong pai ta, en vaw, lapi' ta lano tungah tuang ahi aw!”
Jesu' nungzuite in a tuungin hih thute a tel loh uh hangin Jesu' min a kiphat ciangin ama' vai genna-in hih thute a kigelh ahihlam leh hih thute ama' tungah a kibawl ahihlam phawk uh hi.
Hankhuk sungpan Lazarus samkhia-in misite' lakpan a thawhkiksak lai-a Jesu tawh a om mihonpi in tua thu mah teci pangsuak uh hi.
Jesu dawn dinga mihonpi a paina uh a hang pen hih kihilna lim Jesu in bawl cih a zak man uh ahi hi.
Tua hangin Pharisee-te khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Bangmah na cih thei kei uh hi. En un, leitung in amah zui khinta hi,” ci uh hi.
Tu-in biakpiakna nei dinga pawi hong paite lakah Greek mi kimkhat kihel hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee gam Bethsaida khuami Philip' kiangah amaute pai uh a, “Sya aw, Jesu ka mu nuam uh hi,” ci-in ngen uh hi.
Philip zong pai-in Andrew' kiangah gen a, tua ciangin Andrew leh Philip pai-in Jesu' kiangah gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Mihing' Tapa a min kiphat ding hunlenai tung ta hi.
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah mangbuhhum tang pen lei ah kia-in a muat keileh amah bek mah hi den ding a, a muatleh tampi gah ding hi.
Ama' nuntakna a iplah peuhpeuh tua nuntakna a susia hi a, hih leitung a nuntakna a mudah peuhpeuh tawntung nuntakna' adingin tua nuntakna a kem ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in kei' ading nasem ahihleh kei hong zuih kul a, kei' omna ah keima' nasemte zong hong om ding hi. Mi khatpeuh in kei' ading nasem ahihleh Pa in zong amah pahtawi ding hi.
“Tu-in ka nunna kha gim mahmah hi. Bang ka ci ding hiam? ‘Pa aw, hih hunlenai pan hong honkhia in,’ ka ci ding hiam? Hilo hi, hih thu hang mahin hih hunlenai ah hong pai ka hi hi.
Pa aw, nangma' min sangkhan ta in.” Tua ciangin vantung pan awging khat om a, “Ka sangkhan khinzo a, ka sangkhan lai ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua muna a ding mite in awging za uh a, van ging ci uh hi. A dangte in, “Vanmi khat in amah hopih hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in dawng a, “Hih awging pen kei' ading hilo-in no teng khualna-a hong pai ahi hi.
Tu-in hih leitung thukhenna hita a, tu-in hih leitung-uk mangpa kihawlkhia ding hi.
Tua hi a, kei zong leitung pan hong kikhaitoh ciangin mi khempeuh ka kiangah ka kai ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih bang a gen ciangin amah bangci danin si ding cih a lak ahi hi.

Tua ciangin mihonpi in, “Thukhun panin ‘Khris a tawntungin om’ cih thu ka zazo uh hi. Bang hangin Mihing' Tapa a kikhaitoh kul ding ci thei na hi hiam? Hih Mihing' Tapa na cih kua ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Note lakah khuavak tawmvei sung omlai hi. Khuamial in hong phak loh nadingin khuavak na neih sungun lampai un. Khuamial sunga lampaite in a paina uh koi lam cih thei lo uh hi.
Khuavak' tate na suah theih nadingun khuavak na neih sungun tua khuavak um un,” ci hi. Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu paikhia a, amaute' muh loh dingin bu hi.
Amaute' mai-ah kihilna lim tampi a bawl hangin amaute in um tuanlo uh hi.
Tua pen kamsang Isaiah' thugen a tangtunna ahi hi: “Topa aw, ka thugen uh kua in um a, Topa' khut kua' tungah kilang ahi hiam?”
Hih thu hangin amaute in um theilo uh hi. Isaiah mah in hih bangin na gen lai hi:

“Amah in amaute' mit mangsak a, a lungsim uh khauhsak hi. Tua hikeileh amaute in a mit uh tawh mukha-in a lungsim uhah zong telkha-in hong kiheikha ding uh a, tua hileh amaute ka damsak hong kul ding ahi hi.”
Hih bangin Isaiah in a cih pen Khris' minpha mu-in ama' thu a gen ahi hi.
Himah taleh uliante-a kipan mi tampi in Jesu um uh hi. Ahih hangin vengkhawm inn pan Pharisee-te' hawlkhiat ding launa hangin a upna uh pulak lo uh hi.
A hang pen amaute in Pasian' piak minpha sangin mite' piak minpha lunggulhzaw uh ahih man hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu kiko-in hih bangin thugen hi: “Kei hong um peuhmah, kei hong um hilo-in kei hong sawlpa a um ahi hi.
Kei hong mu peuhmah in kei hong sawlpa zong a mu ahi hi.
Kei hong um peuhmah khuamial sungah a omsuak loh nadingin leitung ah khuavak bangin kong pai hi.
Mi khatpeuh in ka thugente za-in a zuih keileh thu ka khen kei ding hi. A hang pen leitung mite mawhsak thukhen ding hilo-in a honkhia dingin hong pai ka hizaw hi.
Kei hong nolhin ka thugente a sanglo mi in thukhen mangpa khat nei hi; ka genkhiat khitsa thu in ni tawpni ciangin amah thukhen ding hi.
A hang pen kei' ut thu tawh thu ka gen nai kei a, kei hong sawlpa Pa mahmah in bang gen bang pau ding ci-in thupiak khat hong ap khinzo hi.
Ama' thupiakna pen tawntung nuntakna ahihlam ka thei hi. Tua hi a, ka gen thute pen Pa' hong gen bang lianin ka gen ahi hi.”
